# Operations review

## Observations

- Lease signing should take under a day by the end of the pilot, on the condition that landlords accept digital signatures.
- Cutting the courier fee should lift orders by a tenth by June even if the rival matches it, because our base fee would still be lower.
- Moving the batch job to the new server will bring its runtime under 20 minutes by Friday.
